plugins.name: aris
plugins.description: ARIS (Autonomous Research In Sleep) - academic research automation skills

plugins.name: core
plugins.description: Base bundle — runtime hooks, MCP (LSP + AST grep + Codex), generic agents, and common slash skills (commit/PR, review, handoff, docs, rules)

plugins.name: frame
plugins.description: Opt-in code-work guardrails behind per-project markers (.inlay/.ponytail/.showcase) — one dispatcher routes hook events to active guardrails

plugins.name: expert
plugins.description: Advanced/heavyweight tools — Python REPL MCP server (future ralph-like workflow skills)

plugins.name: hud
plugins.description: Heads-Up Display statusline — live session state from Claude Code stdin (cwd, git branch, rate limits, context %, model)

plugins.name: oc-browser
plugins.description: Isolated headed Chromium in Docker via `oc-as <name> browser <action>` — host/vnc/headless modes, per-project containers

plugins.name: research
plugins.description: Research workflow skills - journal, plan, report, commit

plugins.name: usefable
plugins.description: Fable-tier agents — fable- prefixed top-model variants of core's executor and review/verification agents

plugins.name: plugin-devtool
plugins.description: Plugin-author tooling for this marketplace — get-ticket queries the global feedback tickets that core:ticket publishes. Not needed in ordinary sessions
